{{TOCRWI}}

'''Pacific eSports''' is a professional League of Legends based in Philippines.

== History ==

== Timeline ==
{{TDRight
|name2=2014
|content2=
* April , Pacific eSports reforms. '''[[VYY]]''', '''[[Astarte (Judge Cruz)|Astarte]]''', '''[[Misery (John Winston Hernaez)|Misery]]''', '''[[Si Yoo Tae]]''' (now '''Shoti''') and '''[[Wa Chi Phe]]''' (now '''Hakaw''') join.
* May 4, qualifiers for [[2014 PGS Summer]].
* July 12, [[Astarte (Judge Cruz)|Astarte]] moves back to support position while '''[[HongJu]]''' and '''[[Ral]]''' join, [[Hakaw]] moves to sub.
* October 6, [[VYY]] leaves.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/WargodsLOL/posts/318062981711667 Wargods' Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref>

|name1=2013
|content1=
* February 28, '''[[Manila Eagles]]''' recruit players from '''Pacific eSports'''. [[VYY]], [[Astarte (Judge Cruz)|Astarte]], [[H4T3]], [[PF]] and [[Vileroze (Judan Royeca){{!}}Vileroze]] leave. <ref>[http://esports.garena.ph/?p=5737 Manila Eagles: Rising from the Ashes] ''esports.garena.ph''</ref>
}}
